### Steps to reproduce your issue

1. Import tflite model
```
iree-import-tflite esrgan.tflite -o esrgan.tosa.mlir
```
2. Compile model
```
iree-compile --iree-input-type=tosa --iree-hal-target-backends=vulkan --iree-hal-target-backends=metal esrgan.tosa.mlir -o esrgan.gpu.mlir
```
3. Run the model
I run the nightly version of the runtime via [iree.gd](https://github.com/RechieKho/iree.gd). It uses iree with version `candidate-20240106.762`.

### What component(s) does this issue relate to?

Runtime

### Version information

candidate-20240106.762

### Additional context

_No response_
issue.title: Bytecode execution fails when it targets both `vulkan` and `metal`.
